sets.relationshipLabel: worker and the tool central to their trade
sets.explanation: Each artisan is defined by the one implement most associated with their craft.

sets.relationshipLabel: raw material transformed into crafted material
sets.explanation: Each raw substance is processed into the finished material craftspeople actually work with.

sets.relationshipLabel: tool and the feature it inherently has
sets.explanation: Every one of these tools necessarily has this structural part as a defining feature, not an accessory.

sets.relationshipLabel: an action and the action that undoes it
sets.explanation: Each second action structurally reverses the first, unmaking exactly what the first action made.
